cases.description: A non-recursive inductive whose single field mentions no inductive: accepted, so the recursor the builder spells out is exactly the one the kernel derives.
cases.name: positive-control

cases.description: `Bad | mk : ((Bad → Prop) → Prop) → Bad`: `Bad` occurs to the left of an arrow inside a field. The field is not a recursive argument, so recursor construction goes through; only strict positivity rejects it.
cases.name: non-strictly-positive

cases.description: `axiom foo : Sort u` with no universe parameters declared: `u` is unbound.
cases.name: undefined-universe-parameter

cases.description: A constructor whose field mentions a constant named `_nested.X`: the prefix is reserved for the kernel's own nested-inductive auxiliaries.
cases.name: reserved-nested-prefix

cases.description: `unsafe def f : Prop := g` and `unsafe def g : Prop := f` as one mutual block.
cases.name: mutual-unsafe-pair

cases.description: A mutual block mixing an `unsafe` and a `partial` definition.
cases.name: mutual-mixed-safety

cases.description: A mutual unsafe block whose two definitions declare different universe parameters.
cases.name: mutual-mismatched-universes
cases.targets: check.rs: add_mutual (one universe list per block)

cases.description: `Eq`, then `Quot`, `Quot.mk`, `Quot.lift` and `Quot.ind` by their own records with their canonical types, `quotLiftReduction : Quot.lift f h (Quot.mk r a) = f a` by `Eq.refl` (it checks only where the lift computes) and `inductive T : Prop | T.intro`. The control every quotient case below differs from.
cases.name: quotient-package
cases.targets: check.rs: add_quot; the quotient's computation rule in every engine

cases.description: `Quot.mk` an ordinary axiom with the canonical type, in place of its record: once `Quot` is declared the quotient's four names are its own, as Lean's kernel declares all four at once. Admitted, it would let the lift compute on whatever the axiom builds (Arena `bugs/axiom-quot-mk`).
cases.name: quotient-ctor-as-axiom
cases.targets: check.rs: check_name (a begun quotient owns its names)

cases.description: `Quot.lift` an ordinary axiom with the canonical type, in place of its record.
cases.name: quotient-lift-as-axiom
cases.targets: check.rs: check_name (a begun quotient owns its names)

cases.description: `Quot.ind` an ordinary axiom with the canonical type, in place of its record.
cases.name: quotient-ind-as-axiom
cases.targets: check.rs: check_name (a begun quotient owns its names)

cases.description: `Quot` an ordinary axiom with the canonical type, in place of its record: no quotient has begun, so the axiom is admitted, and `Quot.mk`'s record then finds the name taken by a constant that is not the quotient's type.
cases.name: quotient-type-as-axiom
cases.rejected_by: 'Quot' is declared, but not as the quotient's type
cases.targets: check.rs: add_quot (each member declared is the quotient's own)

cases.description: `def Quot {α : Sort u} (r : α → α → Prop) : Sort u := α`, then the other three records: read over this definition `Quot.ind` would cover every inhabitant of `α` (Arena `bugs/forged-quot-type`).
cases.name: quotient-type-as-definition
cases.rejected_by: 'Quot' is declared, but not as the quotient's type
cases.targets: check.rs: add_quot (each member declared is the quotient's own)

cases.description: `axiom Quot.mk : Prop` before any quotient record, then the package: an ordinary constant may take a quotient's name while no quotient is declared (see `quotient-names-without-a-quotient`), but the quotient cannot then be declared over it.
cases.name: quotient-ctor-declared-first
cases.rejected_by: 'Quot.mk' is declared, but not as the quotient's constructor
cases.targets: check.rs: add_quot (each member declared is the quotient's own)

cases.description: `Eq` and `axiom Quot.mk : Prop`, with no quotient record anywhere: Lean's kernel admits an ordinary constant of that name while the quotient is not declared, and so does this one.
cases.name: quotient-names-without-a-quotient
cases.targets: check.rs: check_name (only a begun quotient owns its names)

cases.description: The package with `Quot.ind`'s record before `Quot.mk`'s: the induction principle's type names the constructor, which is not declared yet.
cases.name: quotient-ind-before-ctor
cases.targets: check.rs: add_quot (the constants a canonical type names come first)

cases.description: After `Quot`'s record, `inductive T : Prop | Quot.mk : T`: a constructor of another inductive may not take the quotient constructor's name.
cases.name: quotient-ctor-named-by-a-constructor

cases.description: After the records of `Quot`, `Quot.mk` and `Quot.lift`, `inductive Quot.ind : Prop | Quot.ind.intro`: an inductive type may not take the induction principle's name.
cases.name: quotient-ind-named-by-an-inductive

cases.description: After `Quot`'s and `Quot.mk`'s records, the mutual unsafe pair `f : Prop := Quot.lift` and `Quot.lift : Prop := f` (`mutual-unsafe-pair`'s shape): no member of a block, the first or a later one, may take the lift's name.
cases.name: quotient-lift-named-in-a-mutual-block
cases.targets: check.rs: check_name on every member of a mutual block
